3: For he is my God, and my savior; my helper, I shall not be moved very much.
4: How long will you assault a man? you are all slaughtering as with a bowed wall and a broken hedge.
5: They only took counsel to set at nothing my honor: I ran in thirst: with their mouth they blessed, but with their heart they cursed. Pause.
6: Nevertheless do you, my soul, be subjected to God; for of him [is] my patient hope.
7: For he [is] my God and my Saviour; my helper, I shall not be moved.
8: In God [is] my salvation and my glory: [he is] the God of my help, and my hope is in God.
9: Hope in him, all you congregation of the people; pour out your hearts before him, for God is our helper. Pause.
10: But the sons of men are vain; the sons of men are false, so as to be deceitful in the balances; they are all alike [formed] out of vanity.
11: Trust not in unrighteousness, and lust not after robberies: if wealth should flow in, set not your heart upon it.
12: God has spoken once, [and] I have heard these two things, that power is of God;
13: and mercy is your, O Lord; for you will recompense every one according to his works.
